name: Capterra: Product Search
summary: Discover Capterra products by keyword. Returns one row per unique product (deduplicated by /p/<id>/<slug>/reviews URL).
description: Search Capterra by keyword and return a deduplicated list of product candidates with rating, review count, and the canonical /p/<id>/<slug>/reviews/ URL. Use to discover product URLs to feed into capterra/product-details-reviews.

'' : t; };const site = cleanArg(arg1); const q = cleanArg(arg0); if (!q) throw new Error('search_query is required'); const target = 'https://www.capterra.com/search/?query=' + encodeURIComponent(q);let url; try { url = new URL(target); } catch (_) { throw new Error('not a URL: ' + target); }if (url.hostname !== site && !url.hostname.endsWith('.' + site)) throw new Error('URL must be on ' + site + ': ' + target);const strip = (u) => u.replace(/#.*$/, '').replace(/\/$/, '').replace(/\/\?/, '?');if (strip(location.href) === strip(target)) return { how: 'already_here', url: location.href };const onSite = location.hostname === url.hostname;const link = onSite ? Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a[href]')).find((a) => { try { const u = new URL(a.href); return strip(u.href) === strip(target); } catch (_) { return false; } }) : null;window.__rzn_leaving = { url: location.href, body: document.body };document.querySelectorAll('article, h1, a[href], script[type="application/ld+json"]').forEach((e) => e.setAttribute('data-rzn-stale', ''));if (link) { link.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); link.removeAttribute('target'); link.click(); return { how: 'clicked', url: target }; }location.assign(target); return { how: onSite ? 'in_site' : 'entered', url: target };

inputs.script: const challengeSel = "iframe[src*='captcha-delivery.com'], iframe[src*='challenges.cloudflare.com'], #challenge-form, #challenge-running, #cf-challenge-running, .cf-turnstile, iframe[src*='hcaptcha.com']";const isChallenge = () => { const title = (document.title || '').toLowerCase(); if (/just a moment|verification required|attention required|verify you are human|access denied/.test(title)) return true; if (document.querySelector(challengeSel)) return true; const body = document.body ? document.body.innerText || '' : ''; return body.length < 4000 && /verification required|slide right to|verify you are human|unusual activity from your device/i.test(body); };const check = () => { if (isChallenge()) return 'challenge'; const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(arg0)); const stale = (e) => e.hasAttribute('data-rzn-stale'); if (!all.some((e) => !stale(e))) return null; const lv = window.__rzn_leaving; if (lv && location.href === lv.url && document.body === lv.body && all.some(stale)) return null; return 'ready'; };let state = check();if (!state) state = await new Promise((resolve) => { const obs = new MutationObserver(() => { const v = check(); if (v) { obs.disconnect(); resolve(v); } }); obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true }); setTimeout(() => { obs.disconnect(); resolve(check() || 'timeout'); }, Number(arg1) || 20000); });if (state === 'challenge') throw new Error('site_challenge: ' + location.hostname + ' is showing a bot check ("' + document.title + '"). Solve it by hand in that tab; runs for this site pause for 15 minutes.');if (state === 'timeout') throw new Error('page did not render ' + arg0 + ' at ' + location.href);window.__rzn_leaving = null; return { ready: true, url: location.href, title: document.title };

inputs.script: const cleanArg = (v) => { const t = String(v == null ? '' : v).trim(); return /^\{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\}$/.test(t) ? '' : t; }; const query = cleanArg(arg0); const norm = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const anchors = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("a[href*='/p/'][href*='/reviews/']")); const byProduct = new Map(); for (const a of anchors) { const url = a.href.replace(/[?#].*$/, ''); const idMatch = url.match(/\/p\/(\d+)\/([^/]+)\/reviews/); if (!idMatch) continue; const productId = idMatch[1]; const slug = idMatch[2]; const text = norm(a.textContent); if (!byProduct.has(productId)) { byProduct.set(productId, { product_id: productId, slug, product_url: url, candidates: [] }); } byProduct.get(productId).candidates.push(text); } const results = Array.from(byProduct.values()).map((entry) => { const ratingText = entry.candidates.find((t) => /\d(\.\d+)?\s*\(\d/.test(t)) || ''; const ratingMatch = ratingText.match(/(\d(?:\.\d+)?)\s*\(/); const reviewMatch = ratingText.match(/\(([\d,]+)\)/); const named = entry.candidates.find((t) => t && !/^\d/.test(t) && !/View all/i.test(t) && t.length > 1); return { product_id: entry.product_id, product_name: named || entry.slug.replace(/-/g, ' '), product_url: entry.product_url, rating: ratingMatch ? ratingMatch[1] : 'N/A', review_count: reviewMatch ? reviewMatch[1].replace(/,/g, '') : 'N/A' }; }); return { query: query || null, count: results.length, results };

help.summary: Discover Capterra products by keyword. Returns one row per unique product (deduplicated by /p/<id>/<slug>/reviews URL).
returns: Object: { query, count, results: [{ product_id, product_name, product_url, rating, review_count }] }. Feed product_url into capterra/product-details-reviews.
notes: Dedup is by Capterra product id (the numeric segment in /p/<id>/<slug>/reviews/).
Rating + review count are parsed from anchor text matching '4.5 (1234)'.

Runs for this site queue behind each other and reuse one parked tab, so parallel calls do not speed anything up. If the site shows a captcha or verification wall, the run fails with site_challenge and the site pauses for 15 minutes; solve the challenge by hand in the parked tab.
